question: Who speaks at the Jnanottara's opening?
premises: at the supreme-knowledge opening the Great Lord speaks
what he speaks as sages gods Brahma Visnu Rudra declared
inference: Maheśvara voices the transmitted declaration of all authorities.
uncertainties: list kept as given, order preserved
plain_english: And at the supreme-knowledge beginning the Great Lord speaks indeed — what sages gods Brahma Visnu Rudra and the rest declared.
